text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the incident— 
hearing that a festival was being held at 
the shrine, 
we decided to slip in quietly and observe.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! Quite a bustling crowd, wouldn't 
you say?! 
Smooth sailing all the way!
choice_data_list:
It's a little lonely having to watch from 
the shadows, though...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, it can't be helped. We played the 
villains to perfection last time, after 
all. 
Besides, watching over them from the 
shadows like this 
feels rather ninja-esque, wouldn't you—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
—U-Um. You're No Reason 
...aren't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What?! The priestess?! Bad news, retreat! 
Deploy the smoke bombs—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-wait! 
Please, let me thank you! I just had to 
say thank you!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Say whaaat?! 
You saw right through our charade?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Once the dust had settled, I remembered 
what you said, 
No Reason—about stratagems and having the 
resolve to carry them through.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was our own town, we'd gone 
and forgotten the shrine's origins. 
But thanks to you two, 
we were able to remember.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
To go so far as playing the villain on 
purpose... 
We truly cannot thank you enough.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, cease this at once! The notion 
that we acted out of selfless martyrdom 
is utterly absurd—nay, offensive!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
True, I resolved to lend you aid. 
It would have been a shame to see a legend 
symbolizing 
the bonds between Umamusume and humans 
fade into oblivion, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...However! Playing the part of the wicked 
warlord and her strategist 
was an absolute blast for us!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A villainous commander who sought to 
beguile the hearts of men and subjugate 
the realm, 
only to be undone by the sacred ties of 
community! 
Is that not a thoroughly thrilling tale in 
its own right?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, we've been found out, huh~. 
So we won't be remembered as notorious 
tyrants after all~? 
Is that so~? Well, what a darn shame, 
truly~.
choice_data_list: (...She doesn't seem to mind one bit.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
...No! You will be remembered! 
Not as villains, but as our benefactors!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Please, follow me! 
There is something I must show you!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enshrined in a corner of the grounds... 
stood a gleaming, life-sized 
golden statue of No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I recalled how back then, 
No Reason, you mentioned you were going to 
erect a golden statue.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Alongside a monument engraved with your 
tale, 
we intend to keep it here at the shrine. 
Yes... for all eternity!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... This leaves something to be 
desired! 
If you're going to build one, couldn't you 
have made it much more colossal?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, just a jest, a jest! 
I shall accept your gracious sentiment 
with heartfelt pride.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it pleases you, just as my statue 
watches over this town, 
I hope you all will watch over us in turn.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For in the racing world, 
we shall stir up upheavals that shake the 
heavens!

title: Standing as Steadfast as the Mountain
